Let's take him home first. I know a way to find out the street.
（They're sitting at a computer at home.）
Nana
Let's try all the possible ones on the map.
（After some time）
Jiajia
Now we've got Gaoyuan Street, Taoyuan Street and Zaoyuan
Street. What next？
Nana Some streets may not have a number 129. Let's check.

Nana
So it's Gaoyuan Street or Taoyuan Street.

Gaoyuan Street is really far from here. But the dog didn't look

Nana

Mum
Sure.

Nana
Hi, is this your dog？
Old woman
Yes! My Dabao! Where did you go? I was so

Nana

Old woman
